name: grappler
brief: Grappler: a heavy hostile walker, ~2.0 m, that harpoons a player on a cable, reels them in off their boots and lets go. Industrial cargo-hauler repurposed: hunched, broad-shouldered, heavier and squatter than the Gunner, wide stance, chunky mag-boot feet. Right arm a fat harpoon launcher with a barbed hook at the muzzle; a cable runs from it over the shoulder to a big winch drum on its back that spins when reeling. Left arm a heavy three-fingered claw. One sensor eye. Oxide red-brown paint, bone accents and plates, dark metal joints, pale green-white eye, amber power and winch lights. Weak spot: the winch's magenta power cell on its back under the drum, hidden from the front. Affix parts: bolted armour slabs, a shield emitter ring, overclock radiator fins and a vent, volatile canisters.
